title: HTTP CLI standard version surface
description: Shapes of the data payloads returned by the standard version commands: /version/current (a version object) and /version/releases (an array of release objects, newest first).

protocol_version.description: Protocol version implemented. Must agree with root help's protocol_version.

server_version.description: Implementation version. Must agree with root help's server_version when both are present.

released_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of this release, e.g. 2026-10-14T08:00:00Z.
RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the release.

yanked.description: True when the release was withdrawn.

releasesList.description: Release objects, newest first. 'releases?since=<v>' returns only releases newer than <v>; when <v> is the current version the list is empty.
